description: Interactive: explains one Databricks concept step by step from the Field Guide's chapters: delta-transaction-log, liquid-clustering-vs-zorder, spark-shuffle-and-stages, unity-catalog-privilege-inheritance, photon-vs-classic-cost, cluster-autoscaling, streaming-watermarks, medallion-layers, lakebase-branching, serverless-vs-classic, mlflow-model-lifecycle. Call it first when the user asks "how does the Delta transaction log work?", "show me watermarks step by step" or "visualise Unity Catalog privilege inheritance", rather than answering from memory or running code. Every point comes with the guide's own sentence and its section URL; the result also carries a worked example and the data an interactive model draws (a Delta log to step through, files skipped under each layout, Spark stages and skew, Unity Catalog grants on a tree, cost curves from the guide's rates, a warehouse's day, a watermark timeline, and more), with what the model assumes said apart from what the guide states. In a host that renders MCP Apps it opens as an interactive view; the text is complete without it. Unknown or no concept: the list.

concept.description: The concept: delta-transaction-log, liquid-clustering-vs-zorder, spark-shuffle-and-stages, unity-catalog-privilege-inheritance, photon-vs-classic-cost, cluster-autoscaling, streaming-watermarks, medallion-layers, lakebase-branching, serverless-vs-classic, mlflow-model-lifecycle. A plain name works too ("watermarks", "z-order", "photon"). Omit it, or name one that isn't there, for the list.
